name: dcm2niix-setup
label: dcm2niix setup
description: Setup command that converts the DICOM files staged into /input to NIfTI in /output, so NIFTI-consuming wrappers can run directly on a DICOM-only scan.
command-line: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; dcm2niix -b y -z y -f %p_%s -o /output /input; if ! find /output -type f \( -iname "*.nii" -o -iname "*.nii.gz" \) | grep -q .; then echo "dcm2niix produced no NIfTI output from the DICOM input" >&2; exit 2; fi'
